def factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_smoothed_cumulative(df):
    """Cumulative overnight-intraday cycle dominance with EMA smoothing of the normalized ratio."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    window = 120
    overnight_cum = overnight_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()
    intraday_cum = intraday_ret.rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()
    total_abs = (overnight_ret.abs().rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum() + intraday_ret.abs().rolling(window, min_periods=1).sum()).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    raw_ratio = ((overnight_cum - intraday_cum) / total_abs).fillna(0.0)
    smooth_ratio = raw_ratio.ewm(span=30, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_smoothed_cumulative"] = smooth_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_cycle_smoothed_cumulative"]
description: Crossover preserves the cumulative overnight-minus-intraday cycle dominance mechanism from parent alpha-market-cycle-0-2 as the primary signal. The lightweight modifier borrowed from g1_mutation_alpha_market_cycle_0_2_ddee50ad is post-normalization EMA smoothing (span=30). This smoothing reduces day-to-day noise in the normalized ratio while retaining the longer-horizon cyclical phase estimate, aiming to improve level IC/RankIC without sacrificing the stable ICIR/RankICIR core. The economic interpretation remains a smoothed measure of whether overnight or intraday returns dominate the trailing 120-day window. Cross-sectional transform remains none because the raw payoff mechanism is preserved and the signal is already continuous and comparable within a stock’s own history.
